It's basically DDM’s version of power levels.
Baseline. Can't change reality at all. Something like a rock would have an ARC level of 0.

Stuff like enhanced strength/stamina, maybe minor telepathy or heightened empathy. It's normal for an

Additionally, ARC level does not decide whether or not someone would win a fight; it only decides which would come out on top if two conflicting abilities were to interact.

might be able to stop time, but an opponent with an ARC level of
would be able to restart time again.

It's basically DDM’s version of power levels.
ARC LEVELS DEFINED
ARC LEVEL
0
Baseline. Can't change reality at all. Something like a rock would have an ARC level of 0.
ARC LEVEL
1
Most humans are around ARC Level 1 (or below). Essentially, your non-magical, boring person with an average lifespan.
ARC LEVEL
2
Stuff like enhanced strength/stamina, maybe minor telepathy or heightened empathy. It's normal for an
ACE
to be a high 1, possibly a 2 in special cases.
ARC LEVEL
3
Level 3 is more straight up magic stuff like controlling/summoning fire, transforming yourself or other things, making portals. Most Contractors are above Level 3.
ARC LEVEL
4
Level 4 would involve being able to alter reality in a significant way like being able to destroy a city in a second or slow time.
ARC LEVEL
5
Effectively a god. The Council is ARC level >5.
ARC can increase or decrease due to a variety of factors. It is noted that
ARC levels can spike during heightened emotional states
.
Additionally, ARC level does not decide whether or not someone would win a fight; it only decides which would come out on top if two conflicting abilities were to interact.
As an example, someone with an ARC level of
4.2
might be able to stop time, but an opponent with an ARC level of
4.4
would be able to restart time again.
CONTRACTOR'S DEATHS EXPLAINED
In all current known cases, Contractors are mortals who have been killed by unnatural causes.
A Contractor's death is typically considered a very private matter. However, when a Contractor is close to The Motel, the neon sign (which typically depicts a canine or lupine creature) above the motel will change to reflect that Contractor's manner of death (i.e the dog will be headless or perhaps impaled).
If more than one Contractor is present, then the death of the Contractor with the highest ARC level will be displayed.
ANIMAL FORMS & TRANSFORMATION
All Contractors have the ability to transform into an animal. This ability can generally be controlled, though a Contractor
may shift unwillingly
during moments of high emotional stress.
All Contractor's animal forms are
unique
, though this is not particularly strict; for example, different breeds of the same type of animal seem to be permitted.
Animal forms are restricted to
animals that have existed in baseline Earth
; this includes fish, birds and insects.  It is not currently known
why
certain forms are chosen, though it has been suggested that it relates to the Contractor's general temperament.

A NOTE ON IMMORTALITY
Though contractors are considered "immortal" it should be noted that this refers to
functional
immortality.
Contractors cannot age or die and they do not need to breathe or sustain themselves as mortals do, but they can be injured.
Contractors have
enhanced healing capabilities
that are conditionally (and holistically) activated.
The general rule of thumb is that regeneration only kicks in when the injury is considered severe enough to impediment a Contractor's ability to serve
The Cause
. Consider the following examples as a guide:
Immediate Regeneration
Natural Healing
Beheading
Minor Cuts
Multiple Compound Fractures
Bruises
Loss of a Limb
Broken Fingers/Toes
Removal of Major Organ*
Minor Infection
*It is unknown why this would trigger regeneration as technically speaking, a Contractor doesn't need any of their organs to survive.
CONTRACTOR ABILITIES
Immortal [does not age, cannot be killed]
Dimensional Shifting
Shapeshifting*
*into a specific animal form
ADDITIONAL ABILITIES
Typically contractors have at least one supernatural ability I.E: transmogrification, invisibility, flight, controlling an element, etc.
ACES
A contractor can have as many ACEs as they desire, though controlling a large amount of souls can take a physical toll on the contractor.
RESETTING
Contractors [and ACEs] are liable to have their memory reset as a punishment for disobeying
The Council
or failing in their duties to
The Cause
.

GUIDE TO REALITY TEARS
Summary
Reality Tears
, also known as
rifts, reality breaks or dimensional holes
, are portals between one dimension* and another.
Reality tears present a considerable threat to the dimension they occur in, as they allow matter - including living beings - to enter the "host" reality. These beings are
frequently hostile
, requiring the intervention of
DDM Inc personnel
to avoid casualities amongst civilian populations (if present)
These tears occur when the fabric of reality separating two dimensions thins to the point where it cannot sustain the barrier any longer; this can occur via
the extended passage of time
,
high manipulation of elements outside of their natural purpose
, and
outside interference
.
It has been noted that
reality tears
occur more frequently in dimensions which contain
individuals with higher than average
ARC levels
.
A single dimension can experience multiple reality tears, not necessarily at the same time. After experiencing a reality tear, a reality is more likely to have a tear occur again.
Tears range in severity from
Tier 1
(lowest, least dangerous) to
Tier 5
(highest, most volatile)
*
"dimension" here can be interchangeably used with "reality", "world", "universe" or "plane".

Methods for closing or sealing a tear differ between
contractor to contractor
. Generally it requires an ARC level of at least
2.2
to close a reality tear, but teams of ACEs have been known to close Tier 1 tears with Contractor supervision.
Methods observed include, but are not limited to:
-
Chanting or ritual spellwork
- Physical gestures involving "pushing" or "zipping" the tear closed
-
The use of reality sealing tools or weapons
- Mental or psychic forces
-
The use of seals or runic casts
